what: lamps in a room, driven over DMX512
note: This file is the whole of what lighting knows about songs. A map never mentions a lamp and a dimensions file never mentions a capability; the join happens here, in the reader, which is the only layer allowed to know both. A second reader writes its own copy of this file and changes nothing upstream.
